Title: Validate latest same-day RERATE selection
Description: Verify system retains only the most recent RERATE record when multiple same-day RERATE records exist for the same policy
Steps:
1. Submit multiple policy version records for the same policy_number where version_type = RERATE and policy_version_issued_at differs, all received on the same day.
2. Trigger processing.
Expected Results: The system retains only the RERATE record with the latest policy_version_issued_at and rejects older same-day RERATE records.

Title: Validate older consecutive RERATE rejection
Description: Verify older consecutive RERATE versions are rejected when a newer RERATE appears
Steps:
1. Submit a sequence of consecutive RERATE records for a policy with ascending policy_version_issued_at values.
2. Trigger processing.
Expected Results: The system rejects each earlier consecutive RERATE and keeps only the latest RERATE record.

Title: Validate non-RERATE version handling
Expected Results: and null version types are not rejected by RERATE deduplication logic
Priority:
1. Submit policy records of type NEW, CHANGE, and null alongside RERATE records.
2. Trigger processing.
Test Type: The system processes non-RERATE records according to their own rules and does not reject them due to RERATE deduplication.

Title: Validate issue timestamp ordering for same effective date RERATEs
Description: Verify selection uses policy_version_issued_at when multiple RERATEs share the same policy_version_effective_date
Steps:
1. Submit multiple RERATE records with identical policy_version_effective_date but different policy_version_issued_at values.
2. Trigger processing.
Expected Results: The system selects the RERATE record with the latest policy_version_issued_at and rejects the others.

Title: Validate same-day rerate consolidation
Description: Verify exactly one RERATE version is retained for a policy when same-day rerate deliveries occur
Steps:
1. Submit several same-day RERATE records for one policy.
2. Trigger processing.
Expected Results: The system retains exactly one RERATE version for the policy and excludes all other same-day RERATE records from output.

Title: Validate tiebreaker requirement when issue timestamps match
Description: Verify system has a deterministic tiebreaker if policy_version_issued_at values are identical
Steps:
1. Submit two or more same-day RERATE records with identical policy_version_issued_at and differing policy_version_id or policy_version_number.
2. Trigger processing.
Expected Results: The system applies a deterministic tiebreaker (such as highest policy_version_id or policy_version_number) and retains one record while rejecting others.
